q: Does hop one give you something hop two needs?
why: Capability transfer is the only thing that makes a chain real. A token, a role, a file write, a network position, a parser state, a cache entry, a timing window. If nothing transfers, it is not a chain.

branches.action: it is not a chain. report the individual finding and stop pretending
use it against the highest value reachable surface, proving each hop separately
branches.oracle: each hop has its own oracle
